name: toggle-group
title: Toggle Group
description: An animated toggle group for React and shadcn, with single or multiple selection.

meta.details: Toggle buttons sharing one highlight: it travels between items in single mode, and pressed neighbours fuse into one shape in multiple mode. Base UI ToggleGroup behaviour.

docs: Import ToggleGroup and ToggleGroupItem from components/eased/toggle-group/toggle-group. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import. Dark mode follows .dark or data-theme="dark".
